focus_areas: Viscosity and surface tension realism at the liquid-plate interface
Specular highlight consistency with the implied lighting environment
Background object coherence (glasses/stems) to detect generative artifacts
Homogeneity of the sauce texture (absence of unnatural noise or patterns)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the sauce and the plate. Real chocolate sauce often has a very specific 'beading' effect due to surface tension on ceramic. AI images often fail this by making the edge too sharp (like a cutout) or too blurry (like airbrushing). Also, scrutinize the background glasses; AI often struggles with the complex refractions and transparent geometry of glassware.

The sauce has spread into irregular shapes with distinct lobes and thin connecting streams, exhibiting high viscosity. In the background, out of focus, are two glasses containing a dark liquid, likely wine or more chocolate drink, sitting on a textured surface.

To confirm the specific material classification and rule out look-alikes like soy sauce, balsamic glaze, or motor oil based on subtle color/texture cues.
To verify the physical continuity of the liquid and check for floating islands or disconnected pixels within the main mass, ensuring it behaves as a single coherent fluid body.
To assess the overall realism, focusing on the background artifacts and the 'plasticity' of the liquid rendering which may indicate AI generation.
